content.text:
=== original repo compose: maildev + keycloak services ===
      retries: 3

  keycloak:
    container_name: startuphafen-keycloak
    init: true
    restart: unless-stopped
    image: startuphafen-keycloak:26.1.2
    environment:
      KC_HTTP_PORT: 8180
      KC_LOG_CONSOLE_COLOR: 'true'
      TZ: 'Europe/Berlin'
    build:
      context: ./keycloak
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          'CMD-SHELL',
          "exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/9000 && echo -e 'GET /health HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n' >&3 && cat <&3 | grep -q '200 OK'",
        ]
      start_interval: 1s
      start_period: 1m
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
=== frontend client_id config ===

observation.command: echo "=== original repo compose: maildev + keycloak services ==="; grep -A6 "maildev" /workspace/apps/startuphafen-backend/src/assets/docker-compose.yml | head -15; grep -B2 -A20 "keycloak:" /workspace/apps/startuphafen-backend/src/assets/docker-compose.yml | head -40; echo "=== frontend client_id config ==="; grep -rn "client_id\|clientId" /workspace/apps/startuphafen-frontend/src/environments/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; grep -rn "startuphafen_app\|startuphafen" /workspace/apps/startuphafen-frontend/src/environments/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8
